title: CareMirror: Bringing Caregiver Wellbeing into the Dementia Care Ecosystem
abstract: arXiv:2609.17434v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Family caregivers of people living with dementia shoulder emotional and practical responsibilities, yet their own wellbeing often remains peripheral to dementia care. We built CareMirror, an envisioned caregiver wellbeing ecosystem with interconnected caregiver- and clinician-facing interfaces for longitudinal reflection, personalized support, and caregiver-controlled sharing with clinical care. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 14 caregivers, using CareMirror as a design probe to examine how they perceived this ecosystem and what expectations, concerns, and boundaries emerged around clinical connection. Caregivers valued attention to their wellbeing, longitudinal awareness, context-sensitive support, and clinical visibility when it could lead to meaningful follow-up. translated_title: CareMirror：将照护者福祉纳入痴呆症照护生态系统
translated_abstract: 痴呆症患者的家庭照护者承担着情感和实际层面的责任，然而他们自身的福祉往往在痴呆症照护体系中被边缘化。我们构建了CareMirror，这是一个设想中的照护者福祉生态系统，包含相互关联的面向照护者和临床医生的界面，用于纵向反思、个性化支持以及由照护者控制的与临床照护的信息共享。我们对14名照护者进行了半结构化访谈，将CareMirror作为设计探针，以检验他们如何看待这一生态系统，以及围绕临床连接产生了哪些期望、担忧和边界。照护者重视对其福祉的关注、纵向的意识、情境敏感的支持，以及当临床可见性能够带来有意义的后续跟进时的价值。然而，反复的反思可能变得负担沉重或带来情感上的困难，自动的临床共享可能抑制坦诚的披露，参与者希望……
tldr: 该研究提出CareMirror照护者福祉生态系统，并通过对14名痴呆症家庭照护者的访谈发现：照护者重视对自身福祉的关注和可控的临床连接，但反复反思可能成为负担，且自动临床共享可能抑制坦诚披露。
en_tdlr: This study introduces CareMirror, an envisioned caregiver wellbeing ecosystem, and through interviews with 14 dementia caregivers finds that while caregivers value attention to their wellbeing and controlled clinical connection, repeated reflection could become burdensome and automatic clinical sharing could inhibit candid disclosure.
